system.description:
You burrow your arms underground, as they snake their way through the ground before rising up out of the ground to grab an opponent by their ankles, dragging their legs into the ground, immobilizing them. The target creature must make a Dexterity saving th row. On a failure, they are Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.

If a creature is Restrained in this way, you can select one allied creature, excluding yourself, allowing them to spend their Reaction to cast a Jutsu that makes an attack, with a casting time of 1 Action or take the Attack Action, targeting the Restrained creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the range of this jutsu by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select yourself to spend your reaction to cast a qualifying jutsu targeting the affected creature. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the Restrained creature must spend their Action to end the Restrained condition as their entire lower half is drug underground.
